relationships.subject: ACC-NAcC pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective activation of the ACC-NAcC pathway enhances empathic pain intensity in dominant mice

relationships.subject: Galntl6
relationships.evidence_quote: we identified Galntl6 as a key regulator of enhanced synaptic glutamate transmission from ACC to D1-type medium spiny neurons (D1 MSNs) in the NAcC

key_findings: Subordinate mice show stronger empathic pain than dominant mice.
Galntl6+ ACC to NAcC D1 MSN glutamatergic projection mediates social-rank modulation of empathic pain.
